usage: agentware bench swe [-h] --suite SUITE [--seeds SEEDS] [--arms ARMS]
                           [--dry-run] [--format {text,json}]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --suite SUITE         path to the suite directory containing suite.json and
                        task dirs
  --seeds SEEDS         number of seeds per arm (default: 5)
  --arms ARMS           comma-separated arm names (default: with-context,no-
                        context)
  --dry-run             print planned runs as JSON without spawning agents
  --format {text,json}  output format (default: text)
